amendments.title: Amendment of Municipal Code Section 17-9-0129 allowing lawful cannabis dispensaries to modify operations to include medical cannabis without triggering Section 17-9-0129.1
Amendment of Municipal Code Chapter 17-3 by adding Section 17-3-0600 regarding transient-oriented development (TOD) streets
amendments.summary: Adds §17-3-0600, transit-oriented development (TOD) streets: N Western Ave 3600–4859 N and N Ravenswood Ave 4001–4799 N. Eight uses are prohibited on lots abutting a TOD street, and a rezoning of abutting property must be to a B or C1 district with a FAR of at least 3. It also amends §17-3-0308(2) and adds a definition at §17-17-02177.5. Effective on passage.
